_help: Startups, unicorns and mid-size companies on Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters or Oracle Recruiting Cloud (an Oracle site's newest 100 postings are read: boards/oracle.py; Workable's companies are read from Workable's hourly file of all its customers' jobs), and companies of any size on Workday. Workday sites are read last in each run, one at a time (workday_seconds_between_requests apart), for at most workday_minutes_per_run minutes (24 at most; and whatever it says, no Workday site is started once the run is 24 minutes old, since runs come every 30 minutes: Workday gets the rest of each run), sites never tried first and then those tried longest ago (a site that couldn't be read at its last 2 tries waits a day), so each is read about every 3 hours (about 240 a run; about 1,410 sites today); only their newest postings, and one first seen counts as new only if Workday says it went up in the last 7 days. Workday refuses plain requests from GitHub's machines, so they're read through the headless browser there (its search page, as a visitor's browser loads it); a site that shows a bot check or a server error, or doesn't load in time, is skipped for the run, and after 3 such sites in a row Workday waits for the next run (a site that already couldn't be read at its last 2 tries doesn't count, unless it shows a bot check). Set workday_minutes_per_run to 0 to pause the company Workday sites (your own Workday entries in big_tech.json are still read). A company's Workday site isn't read when one of your entries has the company's name (PayPal: your entry reads the same jobs on its Eightfold page). The whole job board of each is checked about every hour (every_hours) for tech roles. Besides the companies listed here, every company that the new-grad lists (targets/new_grad_lists.json) or the lists under find_companies_in link to is added automatically and stays; boards.md on the monitor-state branch lists all of them. A company's first check records what its board lists and emails only the roles posted in the last catch_up_days days. To add one yourself, add {"name": ..., "link": ...} under companies, with a link to its board or any of its postings (for a Workable company: a link to one of its postings, apply.workable.com/<account>/j/<code>; it's matched in Workable's file through its job codes or, failing that, its name). Companies under skip_companies are never checked, and titles with a skip_titles word (gig work like AI training or data labeling) are dropped; keep that list to words that don't also name engineering work ("annotator", not "annotation"). "enabled": false pauses all of the boards.

targets._level_titles_help: Titles with one of these count as tech only if they also name engineering work (role_filter engineering_signals: engineer, developer, scientist, ...), so "Entry-Level Geologist" is left out but "Build & Release Engineer - New Grad" isn't.
